text:
lena: opened PR that updates the migration guide + JS SDK snippet. preview failed with a missing import and one external redirect. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/523

omar: can you confirm this is docs/examples-only? want to know if auto-merge rules apply.

lena: yes only touches /docs/migration-guide and /examples/js/sdk-snippet.js. no runtime code.

ci-bot: docs-preview: FAILED
Error: render error - GET https://cdn.example.com/widgets.js returned 404 during SSR

sophia: quick fix is to inline the widget snippet for preview or vendor it in /static. but long-term we should stop relying on external CDN for preview builds.

omar: aside from the asset, i want to surface a broader question: should examples be covered by CODEOWNERS so docs team auto-gets requests? and can we safely auto-merge trivial docs-only PRs?

lena: i think examples should be in CODEOWNERS. otherwise they sit unreviewed. proposed CODEOWNERS lines:

```
/docs/ @redwood/docs
/examples/** @redwood/docs
```

ci-bot: note: PR edits CODEOWNERS? false

sophia: for auto-merge my proposal: require all of the following -
- label `docs/auto` applied by a human reviewer
- checks: docs-preview, linkcheck, md-lint pass
- PR changes only under docs/ or examples/ (no CODEOWNERS, infra files)
- no changed file matches regex `(private/|\.env$|credentials|PRIVATE_KEY)`
- not during release-freeze window

omar: i like the safety list. one addition: if PR modifies CODEOWNERS, we should explicitly block auto-merge and require admin approval. editing CODEOWNERS can expand reviewers and needs a human thumbs-up.

lena: agreed. also prefer squash merges for docs. auto-merge should post a bot comment summarizing what was merged and who requested it.

ci-bot: idea for GH action steps (pseudo):
```
- on: pull_request.labeled
- if: label == "docs/auto"
- run: run path-safety script (fail if private/ or secrets)
- run: check PR doesn't modify CODEOWNERS
- run: call release-bot API to ensure not in freeze
- if green: call merge API (squash), post audit comment
```

sophia: implementation detail: prefer not to let label be applied by bots. make sure `docs/auto` is added manually by a person. we can check `github.event.sender.type == 'User'` in the workflow.

omar: good call. and add a short grep scan on changed files to discover accidental credential-like strings: `git diff --name-only | xargs grep -E "(PRIVATE_KEY|AWS_SECRET|SECRET_KEY)"` and fail if any match.

lena: release freeze handling - we use release-bot which exposes an endpoint. action should call `release-bot check-freeze` and if freeze active, add label `hold` and comment. tldr: don't merge during freeze automatically.

sophia: about CODEOWNERS change: changing CODEOWNERS itself should require 2 admin approvals and skip automation. we'll add that to the workflow rules.

ci-bot: quick note: changing CODEOWNERS will trigger review requests to teams listed and may delay merges until approvals satisfied.

lena: i'll inline the external widget for now and push. once CODEOWNERS PR is opened to include /examples/** i'll ask a human to add `docs/auto` so the action can run for future tiny fixes.

omar: action items: lena fix preview asset and re-run, sophia draft GH workflow, lena open CODEOWNERS PR, i'll review the safety scripts.

sophia: i'll also make the workflow post an audit comment that includes PR number, actor, merge sha, and timestamp. keep it verbose for SRE/Legal.

lena: thanks all. pinging when i push the inline fix.

(Action summary: sophia -> draft auto-merge workflow, lena -> fix asset + open CODEOWNERS PR, omar -> review safety scripts)
